contract.initial_registration: The owner can register the callback successfully
contract.unregister: The registered callback can be removed successfully
contract.post_unregister_registry: The listener registry is empty immediately after removal
contract.reregistration: The previously removed callback can be registered again successfully
contract.duplicate_reregistration: Repeated registration of the equivalent callback remains idempotent
contract.registry_uniqueness: Duplicate re-registration does not create a second listener entry
contract.callback_identity: Equivalent bound-method callback references resolve to the same logical callback
contract.delivery_once: The re-registered callback receives the emitted event exactly once
contract.registry_preservation: Event delivery does not alter the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
